muntinlupa-sewage-plant-site-clearances.whole: The loan paid for sewage treatment plants and sewer lines across Metro Manila, and all US$275 million was spent. By the World Bank's own count the completed works removed 6,403 tons of organic pollution (BOD) from collected wastewater against a target of 3,556 tons, and served the equivalent of 1,988,462 people against a target of 2.49 million. The two Muntinlupa plants were finished years after the loan closed: the Manila Bulletin reported Maynilad commissioning the Cupang plant, which treats 46 million litres a day, on 30 September 2025, and the Tunasan plant, 20 million litres a day serving about 83,000 customers, on 21 November 2025.
muntinlupa-sewage-plant-site-clearances.searched: Cached ICR00004984 (efficacy section and results table) and the IEG review; web search and fetches on the Cupang and Tunasan plants (Manila Bulletin).

philippines-irrigation-canal-easement-re.whole: The loan rebuilt 58 national irrigation systems, and US$58.0 million of the US$70.36 million was spent. By the Bank's own count 126,184 hectares and 196,442 farmers were covered, and all 924 irrigators' associations in those systems signed management contracts, their performance scored at 99 per cent against a target of 85 per cent. Irrigation fee collection rose from 55 to 60 per cent nationwide, against a target of 86 per cent; collections peaked at 1.92 billion pesos in 2014 and fell to 1.5 billion in 2016 when the government announced the fee would be abolished. The agency also retired 2,523 permanent staff from a workforce of about 6,700. No independent check of these figures was found.
philippines-irrigation-canal-easement-re.searched: Cached ICR00004062 (efficacy section, results tables, staffing footnote) and the IEG review.

rodriguez-ecotourism-site-397-families-r.whole: The project lent money to local governments around Laguna de Bay for small environmental works. By the Bank's own count 51 sub-projects were prepared and 42 of them were commissioned by the time the project closed. Revenue from the lake authority's environmental user fee rose from 55 million pesos in 2003 to 130 million by 2014, and 37 million pesos of it was put back into environmental works, while US$3 million of the loan money was cancelled at closing. These figures come from the lender; no independent check was found.
rodriguez-ecotourism-site-397-families-r.searched: Cached ICR15550 (results framework indicators 3-5, 15 and 16) and the IEG review of October 2015.

raciborz-polder-nieboczowy-village-remov.whole: The dry polder holds 185 million cubic metres of floodwater. The Associated Press put its cost at 2 billion zlotys, about US$520 million, built over roughly a decade with part of the money from the European Union and the World Bank. The completion report adds 59.74 km of flood embankments strengthened and 37.5 km of river and floodway channel widened, and says more than 2.5 million people gained protection. In the floods of October 2020 the polder held close to 45 million cubic metres of water and cut the flood peak downstream by at least 30 per cent, by the Bank's count.
raciborz-polder-nieboczowy-village-remov.searched: Cached ICR (efficacy section, paras 32-37) and the IEG review; Associated Press report on the reservoir in the September 2024 floods, fetched via ABC News.

sources_add.title: Floodwater reservoir becomes Poland's hero for preventing major flooding

west-bank-substation-land-taking-eump.whole: Three of the four substations were finished when the project closed on 30 September 2016, with a combined capacity of 360 MW; the fourth, at Ramallah, with 180 MW, was 15 per cent built. The three carried no power at closing, waiting on a supply agreement with the Israel Electric Corporation, and the Bank expected a first 125 MW, 35 per cent of their capacity, to be energised once it was signed. Over the same years the Bank's figures put bill collection by the West Bank distribution companies at 77 per cent in 2013, up from 49 per cent in 2007, while network losses rose from about 20 to 23 per cent. These figures are the lender's; no independent check was found.
west-bank-substation-land-taking-eump.searched: Cached ICR00002455 (paras 33, 43-44 and the component table) and the IEG review.

kigali-gasabo-electricity-land-retrospec.whole: The credit paid for a new 20 MW heavy fuel oil plant at Jabana and rebuilt parts of the transmission and distribution network. By the Bank's own count available capacity rose from 41 MW in 2004 to 75 MW in 2010, power cuts fell from about 4,500 hours a month in 2004 to none by May 2009, network losses fell from 25 to 16 per cent, and billing as a share of power supplied rose from about 72 to 84 per cent against a target of 98 per cent. No independent figures for what the project delivered were found.
kigali-gasabo-electricity-land-retrospec.searched: Cached ICR17550 (indicator tables and section 3.2) and the IEG review of March 2012.

rwanda-electricity-access-rukarara-reloc.whole: The programme extended the grid to households and public buildings. The Evaluation Group's review records 275,714 households connected under this project against an original target of 100,000 and a revised 148,000, and 810,923 under the wider national programme, at an average cost of US$411 per connection. Schools with electricity rose from 21 per cent in 2009 to 77.2 per cent in 2018, administrative buildings from 38.7 to 94.5 per cent and health centres from 38.4 to 92.1 per cent, each short of its target. Rwanda Energy Group, the utility that ran the rollout, reported in April 2019 that 1,381,405 households were connected and the access rate had reached 51 per cent, 37 per cent of them on the grid; the lender and the utility that did the work are both reporting on their own programme.
rwanda-electricity-access-rukarara-reloc.searched: Cached ICRR (outcome and public-institutions sections; the ICR itself is not in the disclosed document list); Rwanda Energy Group news page on the access rate.

sources_add.title: Electricity access rate reaches 51% from 10% in 9 years

rwanda-hillside-irrigation-relocation-de.whole: The project built radical terraces on 18,383 hectares, applied other soil conservation measures on 3,265 more, and developed 2,555 hectares for irrigation serving 8,671 farmers in seven water user associations. Sediment washing off the project area fell from 54 tonnes per hectare a year in 2011 to 2.6 tonnes in 2016, and 58,855 farmers were trained. The completion report puts maize yields in the project area at 4 tonnes a hectare and Irish potatoes at 25 tonnes by 2018, against national averages of about 2 tonnes for maize and 11.5 for potatoes. All the figures are the lender's own; no independent check was found.
rwanda-hillside-irrigation-relocation-de.searched: Cached ICR00004539 (paras 36-38 and the results framework) and the IEG review of May 2019.

sao-gabriel-cable-station-urban-farmers.whole: The grant connected Sao Tome and Principe to the ACE submarine cable and paid for the landing station. The Evaluation Group's field report records the wholesale price of an international link falling from US$9,000 a month in 2010 to US$2,500 at project close in 2014, and the retail price of internet service from about US$852 a month in 2010 to US$52 at close and US$31 by 2017, which it notes is about a fifth of average monthly income. It gives internet users as 19 per cent of the population in 2010 and about 28 per cent in 2017, with 91 mobile phones per 100 people; the International Telecommunication Union's own country profile, with data as of June 2018, gives 29.9 per cent of people using the internet in 2017 and 85 mobile subscriptions per 100 people.
sao-gabriel-cable-station-urban-farmers.searched: Cached PPAR 126034 (paras 3.50-3.54) and the ICR; ITU LDC country profile for Sao Tome and Principe.

sources_add.title: Country Profile: Sao Tome and Principe (ITU LDC profiles)

tuz-golu-gas-storage-informal-households.whole: Ten of the twelve planned storage caverns were completed; two were dropped for geological reasons, and the contractor enlarged the rest. The caverns hold 0.923 billion cubic metres of working gas against a target of 0.96 billion, by the Bank's count, and US$709.69 million was spent of a US$938.69 million project. The Erzincan compressor station added about 10 billion cubic metres a year of pipeline capacity, short of the 18 billion the project counted as its target, because the second station at Corum was built by BOTAS outside the project. No independent figures for the delivered capacity were found.
tuz-golu-gas-storage-informal-households.searched: Cached ICR (paras 35-36 and results framework); web search for Turkish regulator and BOTAS storage figures, which did not yield a figure matching the project period that could be relied on.

mafinga-igawa-road-deaths-displacement.whole: The project rebuilt the 137.9 km Mafinga-Igawa section of the Dar es Salaam corridor, which took 78 per cent of its money, and US$175.4 million was spent. The Tanzania Revenue Authority measured the time for an imported container to travel from Dar es Salaam to the Malawi border falling from 7 days to 2. Freight on the corridor rose from 35,000 containers a year at appraisal to 81,478 at closing, and daily traffic at the Makambako counting station from 1,716 vehicles in 2011 to 4,444 in 2020, with trucks up from 821 to 1,339. Of 20 roadside health clinics planned, 5 were finished by closing and treated 7,425 patients against a target of 3,000.
mafinga-igawa-road-deaths-displacement.searched: Cached ICR (paras on efficacy, the health clinics and the PDO indicator tables) and the IEG review.

zanzibar-drainage-deaths-compensation.whole: The credit built 20,718 metres of storm water drains outside Stone Town, a landfill of 425,000 cubic metres, 340 metres of sea wall and promenade at Mizingani and 18.26 km of street lighting, and US$87.57 million was spent. By the Bank's own count households suffering flooding in the municipal area fell from 3,645 to 64, people with rubbish collection rose from 75,600 to 187,200, and 412,914 people were counted as direct beneficiaries. One planned piece of work was dropped at the second restructuring: upgrading in the Ng'ambo area, which was to give 3,246 households access to infrastructure and services. No independent check of these figures was found.
zanzibar-drainage-deaths-compensation.searched: Cached ICR00004387 (results framework tables) and the IEG review of April 2022.

bilotserkivka-m03-bypass-house-damage.whole: The loan rebuilt part of the M-03 road and built three bypasses, including the one at Bilotserkivka. At closing 53.5 km had been rebuilt, widened or newly built: 22.5 km rehabilitated, 10.8 km widened from two lanes to four and 20.3 km new, against 86 km first planned and 57.3 km after the targets were cut. Roughness on the rebuilt sections fell from 5 to 2 on the international index, and fatal crashes on them fell from 20 a year to 6, a drop of 72 per cent against a target of 80 per cent; the crash figures in the completion report come from traffic police records. All US$450 million of the loan was disbursed.
bilotserkivka-m03-bypass-house-damage.searched: Cached ICR (paras 38-39, results framework and the note on police crash data) and the IEG review.

bukhara-sewer-pump-station-cleared-plot.whole: The credit rebuilt sewers, pumping stations and the two wastewater treatment plants in Bukhara and Samarkand, and US$132.85 million was spent. In Bukhara city 10 of 16 pumping stations were replaced and 2 rehabilitated, with 4 more replaced later; all six of Samarkand's were rehabilitated and two new ones built. By the Bank's own count 545,775 people benefited; organic pollution removed reached 1,765 tonnes a year at Bukhara's plant against a target of 2,000 and 3,201 tonnes at Samarkand's against 3,100; sewer blockages fell from 1,404 a year to 589 in Bukhara and from 1,056 to 345 in Samarkand; and energy used per kilogram of pollution removed fell from 4.1 to 2.5 units at Bukhara and 4.0 to 1.9 at Samarkand. No independent check of these figures was found.
bukhara-sewer-pump-station-cleared-plot.searched: Cached ICR (paras 31-33 and results framework tables) and the IEG review of December 2022.

ferghana-valley-drainage-land-taken-with.whole: The project rebuilt drainage and irrigation canals in three districts of the Fergana region and counted 583,300 people as beneficiaries, 49 per cent of them women. The completion report of 16 May 2017 reports cotton yields up 11 per cent to 2.7 tonnes a hectare, wheat up 66 per cent to 5.8 tonnes, vegetables up 74 per cent to 34.7 tonnes, and the share of settlement area flooded down from 67.4 to 13.1 per cent. The Evaluation Group's field report of 29 March 2019 disputes the yield gains: set against the Ferghana Valley districts as a whole, it found no net gain for cotton and net falls for wheat, melons and vineyards on leasehold farms, and ministry data for 2017 showing cotton down to 2.2 tonnes a hectare and vegetables down from 28.0 to 24.2 tonnes. Both accounts are the lender's own.
ferghana-valley-drainage-land-taken-with.searched: Cached ICR (indicator tables) and PPAR 2019 (paras 2.34-2.36 and table 2.1), plus the IEG ICR review.

hopewell-road-land-taken-st-vincent.whole: The credit paid for repairs after Hurricane Tomas, and SDR 3.11 million of SDR 3.30 million was spent. Three schools were structurally repaired and 1,144 pupils returned to them; three emergency shelters were rebuilt with separate male and female washrooms, giving places for 2,175 people; a 600-foot section of the Hopewell road was rebuilt with slope stabilisation works; and seven hazard maps and a database of 366 geo-referenced public buildings were produced. The Bank's own economic analysis put the return on the road work at 19.08 per cent and on the schools at 14.72 per cent, counting the damage a future storm would not do. No independent check of these figures was found.
hopewell-road-land-taken-st-vincent.searched: Cached ICR00003178 (indicator tables, para 51 and annex 3 table 1) and the IEG review.

hade-shala-neighbourhood-mine-resettleme.whole: The project paid for cleaning up the Kosovo A ash dump and reclaiming mined-over land; it did not finance the resettlement itself but supervised the ministry's plan. By the Bank's own count ash disposal moved entirely off open dumping to the Mirash mine when a wet ash system started working in December 2013, 74 per cent of the 243-hectare ash dump was remediated, 179 hectares of contaminated land were managed or closed against a target of 156, and 653 hectares of mine overburden land were prepared for reuse against a target of 526. Dust near the dump fell below 100 milligrams per square metre a day by December 2013 and by 2015 below what the six monitoring filters could register. The figures are the lender's; no independent measurement was found.
hade-shala-neighbourhood-mine-resettleme.searched: Cached ICR (PDO indicator tables 1-7) and the IEG review of June 2017.

kasumbalesa-market-traders-moved.whole: The credit rehabilitated the Chingola-Kasumbalesa road, given as 39 km in the completion report's results annex, 40.5 km in its outputs annex and 40 km in the Evaluation Group's review, and SDR 59.98 million was spent. Across the whole project, routine maintenance covered 50 per cent of the main road network by 2014, up from 19.5 per cent in 2004 and two years after the target date; the domestic share of the road budget rose to 66 per cent; and 505,000 rural people gained all-weather river crossings. A system for recording road crashes, due by December 2005, was built in 2014 but was not working at closing. The figures come from the lender and the roads agencies.
kasumbalesa-market-traders-moved.searched: Cached ICR (PDO indicator tables) and the IEG review of June 2015.

kitwe-mufuchani-bridge-relocation.whole: The same credit also rebuilt 51 km of the Lusaka-Chirundu road, after which the share of that section in good or fair condition rose from 50 to 95 per cent, and built 92.5 km of all-season community roads in Chibombo, Mpongwe and Zambezi districts. Five districts were planned for those community roads; cost overruns cut it to three. By the Bank's own count 23,993 rural people in those districts gained an all-season road, against a baseline of 4,178 and a revised target of 4,248. No independent check of these figures was found.
kitwe-mufuchani-bridge-relocation.searched: Cached ICR (PDO indicator tables 1-5) and the IEG review of May 2017.
